backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (TimeEntry, JournalEntry, DailyMediaEntry, Fichier, UserProfile) and persistent storage maps for a time-tracking application with access control, blob storage mixin, and CRUD operations for entries and files.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that time duration formatting (hours-based, e.g. '7h30') has been implemented across Dashboard, Calendar, Reports pages and a shared timeFormatting utility.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON summary catalog describing the purpose and key implementation details of each frontend source file in the project.
frontend/ANDROID_REGRESSION_CHECKLIST.md: Manual QA checklist for verifying that icon-based UI controls work correctly on Android Chrome without DOMException errors, covering navigation tabs, header buttons, rapid tapping, console verification, and admin publish dialog behavior.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the React app, setting viewport meta tags and mounting the root div with the main.tsx module script.
frontend/PRODUCTION_BUILD_RUNBOOK.md: Runbook documenting the repeatable steps to build and verify a production (minified) frontend bundle before publishing, listing prerequisites and build steps.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component handling authentication state, profile setup dialog, session-scoped WelcomeDialog, and tab-based routing between Dashboard, Calendar, Journal, and Reports pages with a mobile bottom nav.
frontend/src/components/DayTypeCheckboxG: Reusable mutually exclusive checkbox-style button group for selecting day type (Travail/Congé/Astreinte) with active state styling and check icon feedback.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React class error boundary that detects Android Chrome removeChild DOMExceptions, logs diagnostics via logDebug, and renders an English-language fallback UI with safe reload and go-back actions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying a copyright notice and a caffeine.ai attribution link with a heart icon.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky app header displaying the TimeTrack logo, version badge, optional username, login/logout button, and an admin-only PublishRetryDialog button, using Internet Identity for authentication.
Fixed bottom navigation bar for mobile (hidden on md+) with four tabs (Dashboard, Calendar, Journal, Reports) that highlights the active page and debounces navigation taps via useSafeTap.
frontend/src/components/PublishRetryDial: Admin dialog that requires confirming an Android regression checklist before triggering a publish workflow restart via the useRestartPublish mutation.
frontend/src/components/WelcomeDialog.ts: Simple welcome modal shown to new users that briefly describes the app's features and provides a 'Get Started' button to dismiss it.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor based on the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout flow, delegation validity checks, and exposing identity and login status to the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for all backend operations including time entries, journal entries, user profile, media, and admin actions, each invalidating relevant cache keys on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSafeTap.ts: Hook returning a wrapper function that debounces rapid taps, prevents concurrent async executions, and defers handler execution to the next animation frame to avoid Android Chrome DOMException crashes.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Tailwind directives, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes (colors, sidebar, charts), and adds mobile-safe utility classes for safe-area insets, touch handling, and overflow prevention.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider (React Query) and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Calendar.tsx: Monthly calendar page that displays, creates, edits, and deletes time entries per day, with a dialog form supporting work hours, astreinte, intervention slots, and day type selection.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Analytics dashboard page showing aggregated time entry stats (normal hours, astreinte, meals, travel, interventions) with bar and pie charts, filterable by weekly, monthly, or yearly periods.
frontend/src/pages/Journal.tsx: Journal page for creating and managing journal entries with text notes, audio recording (with microphone permission handling), photo uploads, and day type tagging.
frontend/src/pages/Reports.tsx: Reports page that displays filtered time entries in a table with totals, and supports exporting data as CSV or PDF for weekly or monthly periods.
frontend/src/utils/buildInfo.ts: Utility that exposes build metadata (mode and optional build timestamp) from Vite environment variables.
frontend/src/utils/debugLogging.ts: Debug logging utility that emits console logs and maintains a circular in-memory history of UI interactions, active only in development mode or when explicitly enabled via localStorage.
frontend/src/utils/timeFormatting.ts: Provides utility functions for formatting and computing time durations stored as hours (bigint/number), including formatting to 'XhMM' strings, computing normal/astreinte/intervention hours from time entry fields.
frontend/src/utils/weekOptions.ts: Provides utility functions for ISO week calculations, including getting week numbers, start dates, and generating a list of week options (with labels) that intersect a given month and year.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius, accordion keyframes, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the project state for 'Heures Tracker', recording existing features, pending feature requests, and metadata such as schema version and clarification settings.
